description: Instant Melee on i76_pristine_fix.exe (run_scenario --nomission --exe i76_pristine_fix.exe --ai 1): one AI opponent as the radar contact, no scripted end. Engine on (radar needs it), the range toggle first, then 10 s of driving so the AI car is inside the radar's 600 m (the first census run's T at frame 574 found no contact; its second T at 1488 locked), then the target keys with repeated T taps from the sandbox input.map: T TARGET_NEAREST_ENEMY (entity_RadarSetTarget -> flags 0x10, bank-1 lock display, CGROWL), R RADAR_RANGE_TOGGLE twice (range index 1 -> 0 -> 1: 600 / 100 m display), Y NEXT_TARGET, Q frontal_target, K RADAR_CAMERA_TOGGLE (target view flag 2) twice, F4 / F5 target and enemy views (camera_mode 4, need the radar target) then F1, Tab weapon_cycle, the lock held through a W+A circle with a weapon_fire burst (Enter), U RESET_TARGET (entity_RadarClearTarget: lock lost), re-acquire with T and lose it again. The melee loadout is one gmmedium machine gun (telemetry weapon_name in every melee run), so 'missile weapon selected' is the Tab cycle over what the car carries; the class-4 lock-on timer (weapons.md) is used by no stock .gdf. The watch thread logs every change of the radar block [[ent+0x434]+0x70] (range, flags, locked contact) and of camera_mode with the frame.
